---
title: "Concentration of Pupils"
params:
  lang: "en"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

task <- "tone2"
plfile <- sprintf("%s.pl", task)
if(!file.exists(plfile))
  plfile <- system.file(file.path("rexams", plfile), package = "mistakes")
rolog::consult(plfile)

hook(x_bar, mean(X))
hook(s_x, s)
hook(n, N)
hook(mu_0, subscript(mu, 0L))

repeat
{
  n <- sample(20:50, 1)
  mu_0 <- 100
  s_x <- round(runif(1, 10, 20), 1)

  # the sample mean may lie above or below the norm
  t <- sample(c(-1, 1), 1) * runif(1, 0.5, 3.0)
  x_bar <- round(mu_0 + t * s_x / sqrt(n), 1)
  tratio <- (x_bar - mu_0) / (s_x / sqrt(n))

  if(abs(tratio) < 0.5 || abs(tratio) > 3.0)
    next

  Q <- substitute(search(task, tone(x_bar, mu_0, s_x, n),
                    .S, .R, .P, .E), list(task = as.name(task)))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  # response options must be distinguishable after rounding
  if(any(duplicated(sprintf("%.2f", sapply(S, FUN="[[", "R")))))
    next

  break
}

tab <- data.frame(Concentration = c(sprintf("%.1f", c(x_bar, s_x)), n))
row.names(tab) <- c("Mean", "SD", "N")

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
```

Question
========
A school psychologist investigates whether pupils at a school with an extended 
sports program differ in their ability to concentrate from the general population. 
A total of $N=`r n`$ pupils complete a standardized concentration test. In the 
general population, the test has a mean of $\mu_0=`r mu_0`$ points. The significance 
level is set to $\alpha=.05$, two-tailed.

````{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, align="r", caption="_Table 1._ Concentration test scores of the pupils.")
````
Do the pupils differ from the general population in their ability to concentrate? 
Please report the two-tailed $p$-value.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The $t$-statistic for one sample is given by $t=\frac{\overline{X}-\mu_0}{s / \sqrt{N}}$. The two-tailed $p$-value is then given by `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
